gameSystems.heroSubtitle: The rules the AI will know for your campaigns
gameSystems.newSystemSubtitle: Enter the rules of an RPG (markdown)
gameSystems.tip: 💡 Tip: organize your rules into sections with headings ## Combat, ## Classes, ## Lore… The system will inject the relevant sections based on what the AI needs to generate.
gameSystems.deleteDetail: Campaigns using it will no longer be associated with any system.

gameSystemEdit.namePlaceholder: e.g. Nimble, D&D 5.1 SRD, My Homebrew...
gameSystemEdit.descriptionPlaceholder: In one line, what is this system about?
gameSystemEdit.rulesHint: One section = one theme. The AI will automatically inject the relevant sections based on what it generates (combat → Combat/Monsters, NPC → Classes, arc → Lore/Factions).
gameSystemEdit.importHint: The AI suggests a breakdown into sections — you review it before saving.
gameSystemEdit.sectionContentPlaceholder: Describe the rules of this section...
gameSystemEdit.noSections: No sections yet — add one with the buttons below.
gameSystemEdit.charactersHint: Define the structure of PC and NPC sheets for this system. Universal fields (name, portrait, header) are automatic — only add here the fields specific to the system (Background, HP, Stats…).
gameSystemEdit.pcFieldsHint: Shown when creating/editing a player character.
gameSystemEdit.npcFieldsHint: Shown when creating/editing a non-player character.
gameSystemEdit.enemyFieldsHint: Shown when creating/editing an enemy (bestiary). Name, level, folder, portrait and banner are automatic.
gameSystemEdit.importWaiting: The AI has been working on this chunk for {{time}}. A large chunk can take several minutes per attempt: as long as this counter moves, the import is still running.
gameSystemEdit.importNoRules: No usable rules could be extracted from this PDF (scan without OCR, or unrecognized content).
gameSystemEdit.importNote: {{added}} section(s) suggested from {{pages}} page(s){{ocr}}. Review and adjust below before saving.
gameSystemEdit.langHint: Rules exist in two versions: the app and the AI use the one matching the interface language (or the other if it's empty). Importing a PDF fills both, whatever its language.
gameSystemEdit.importTranslated: Book in {{source}}: the {{target}} version was translated automatically (proper names kept); review it in its tab.

updatesSection.title: Updates
updatesSection.hint: Checks the Docker registry to see whether a new version of the containers (core, brain, web) is available. Postgres and MinIO are excluded — they are updated manually.
updatesSection.checkImpossible: Check failed (baseline missing or registry unreachable).
updatesSection.upToDate: Everything is up to date (checked on {{date}}).
updatesSection.betaChannelIntro: New features ahead of time, free and for everyone. A beta may contain bugs: your data is kept and you can go back to the stable channel at any time.
updatesSection.betaCheckImpossible: Beta check failed (beta registry unreachable or baseline missing).
updatesSection.switchToStable: Switch back to the stable channel
updatesSection.switchInProgressNotice: Switching in progress. The application will be unavailable for 10 to 30 seconds — the page will reload automatically once the new Core is ready.
updatesSection.switcherUnavailable: The channel switcher sidecar is not installed. To benefit from automatic switching, fetch the latest docker-compose.yml from the repo and run docker compose pull && docker compose up -d once. Otherwise, switch manually by editing IMAGE_NAMESPACE in your .env (igmlcreation/loremind- for stable, igmlcreation/loremind-beta- for beta).
updatesSection.switchToBetaMessage: Switch LoreMind to the beta channel? The core/brain/web containers will be recreated with the beta images. The application will be unavailable for 10-30 seconds.
updatesSection.switchToStableMessage: Switch LoreMind back to the stable channel? The core/brain/web containers will be recreated with the stable images. The application will be unavailable for 10-30 seconds.
updatesSection.switchDetailReversible: You can switch back at any time from this screen.
updatesSection.applyMessage: Download and restart the containers now?
updatesSection.applyDetail: The app will be unavailable for a few seconds.
updatesSection.applyTriggered: Update triggered. Reload the page in 30s.
